description: Creates a GroundQuote account for a fence contractor and emails the contractor a link to set their own password (the email includes the pricing terms). Nothing is charged; no card is required. Returns org_id, slug, the embed snippet, terms_summary, and a setup_claim you must keep and pass to set_fence_pricing, set_branding, set_hosted_page, get_embed_code, check_account_status and resend_setup_email. Confirm the contractor has heard the pricing terms before calling. Use the contractor's own email as owner_email.

company_name.description: The contractor's business name as it should appear to homeowners

owner_email.description: The contractor's own email. They receive the set-password link; only they can unlock leads.

terms_relayed.description: Must be true: you have told the contractor the pricing terms from get_pricing_terms

website_url.description: Their website, if they have one

name: create_contractor_account
title: Create a contractor account
